main.description: Returns an indexed organization sidecar and associated profile for each supplied actor DID. Authentication is not required.

actors.description: Actor DIDs to look up, supplied as repeated unbracketed query values.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An actor DID or query parameter is invalid.

errors.name: OrganizationQueryFailed
errors.description: The indexed organization sidecars or associated profiles could not be queried.

organizations.description: One result per supplied actor occurrence, in request order.

actor.description: Actor DID from the corresponding request occurrence.

organization.description: Hydrated actor view, or null when no indexed organization sidecar exists.
